displayIdentity.body: Saul approves and ravages the assembly. Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles. But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.
displayIdentity.title: Saul approves and ravages the assembly
